description: GitHub Actions pipeline speed and reliability for vitruvian-core, from the operator-managed CI collector.

options.content: GitHub Actions runs of **vitruvian-core**, from the CI collector (spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-cicd-telemetry-design.md`). Data since switch-on (2026-09-28). Individual runs: last 24h (Tempo). **Re-run rate** counts retried runs; it is a flakiness signal, not proof.

panels.title: Run time p50 / p95 by workflow
panels.description: How long a whole workflow run takes: the middle (p50) and the slow end (p95). Each point covers the previous $window (dropdown), because CI runs are sparse.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, cicd_pipeline_name) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cicd_pipeline_name) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)))

panels.title: Runner wait p95 vs job time p95
panels.description: Time jobs spend waiting for a runner, next to the time they spend running. Each point covers the previous $window (dropdown), because CI runs are sparse.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="queue", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="queue", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="queue", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)))

panels.title: Slowest jobs (p95, selected range)
panels.description: The ten jobs with the slowest p95 duration over the time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $__range or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="job", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0))))

panels.title: Slowest steps (p95, selected range)
panels.description: The ten steps with the slowest p95 duration over the time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="step", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="step", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $__range or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="step", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0))))

panels.title: Merge-queue time to green (p95)
panels.description: How long successful merge-queue runs take, slow end, over the time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", ci_trigger="merge_queue", status_code="STATUS_CODE_OK", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow"} - (cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", ci_trigger="merge_queue", status_code="STATUS_CODE_OK", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow"} offset $__range or cicd_duration_seconds_bucket{ci_span_type="run", ci_trigger="merge_queue", status_code="STATUS_CODE_OK", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow"} * 0)))

panels.title: Failure rate by workflow
panels.description: Share of workflow runs that failed. Each point covers the previous $window (dropdown), because CI runs are sparse.

targets.expr: (sum by (cicd_pipeline_name) (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)) or sum by (cicd_pipeline_name) (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (cicd_pipeline_name) (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $window or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)), 1)

panels.title: Failing jobs (selected range)
panels.description: The ten jobs that failed most often over the time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (span_name) (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="job", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="job", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $__range or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="job", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0)))

panels.title: Re-run rate
panels.description: Share of runs that were a retry of an earlier attempt. A flakiness signal, not proof.

targets.expr: (sum((cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", ci_retry="true", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", ci_retry="true", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $__range or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", ci_retry="true", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0))) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum((cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} - (cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} offset $__range or cicd_calls_total{ci_span_type="run", cicd_pipeline_name!~"cicd-telemetry smoke.*", cicd_pipeline_name=~"$workflow", ci_trigger=~"$trigger"} * 0))), 1)
